description: Updates an exercise group. Use when the user wants to change name, exercises, rounds, or rest time. Group IDs come from create_exercise_group.

exercise_ids.description: Replaces the exercises, in order. IDs from list_team_exercises. Omit to keep them.

group_id.description: Exercise group ID, as returned by create_exercise_group.

group_type.description: "circuit" = one exercise after another, then repeat; "sets" = all rounds of one exercise before the next.

name.description: New group name. Omit to keep it.

rest_seconds.description: New rest between rounds in seconds. Omit to keep it.

rounds.description: New number of rounds. Omit to keep it.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

name: update_exercise_group
title: Update exercise group
